title: Makes beautiful landscapes
text: Makes beautiful landscapes. Very happy with this sand art. It only took a few times to get the bubbles right. Makes beautiful landscapes. Only problem is, I think I might be losing it to my grandkids when they see it. I'm sure I'll be back for another one once they convince me to let them take it home with them.
